title: Add a shared parameter to walls and doors: write the definition file, open it, bind it to categories
task: Create a shared parameter and bind it as an instance parameter to the Walls and Doors categories: there is no Application.CreateSharedParameterFile, so write the tab-delimited shared-parameter file with System.IO, set Application.SharedParametersFilename, OpenSharedParameterFile, read the ExternalDefinition, then BindingMap.Insert with an InstanceBinding under a GroupTypeId (BuiltInParameterGroup is gone in Revit 2025+).

pitfalls.symptom: Looking for Application.CreateSharedParameterFile finds nothing; the API cannot create a shared-parameter file.
pitfalls.cause: Only OpenSharedParameterFile and the SharedParametersFilename property exist; the file is plain tab-delimited text.
pitfalls.fix: Write the file with System.IO (META, GROUP, PARAM rows as in step 1), then open it.

pitfalls.cause: BindingMap.Insert's group argument is a ForgeTypeId now.

pitfalls.symptom: After the run, the user's own shared-parameter file is no longer selected in Revit.
pitfalls.cause: SharedParametersFilename is a process-wide setting the script changed.
pitfalls.fix: Capture it before, restore it in a finally block, and delete the temporary file.
